slot_change_request: S-ENGRAM+NORM 1705 v26 CAP spread candidate: same 576.72x51.84 outline; the v21 pins crammed 1,136 inputs into x 225-342 (9.7 b/um) and 2,270 outputs into x 200-350 (~16 b/um over two layers) with clk at the W edge, which drove 13,759 boundary hold buffers into that span (k4 GRT-0116 M3 V 24,647). v26 spreads both faces over the full width in the original bit order (N 0.50 um, S 0.25 um pitch; the ctfn_nt/ctfs_nt chain above is already full-width 5.6 b/um) and puts clk/rst at the N-face centre like ctfn_nt/ctfs_nt. Request posted to S-DIE el1011-s81die.log.

pin_regs.reason: Actual RTL explicitly owns N input capture n_fd/n_fv and S output launch fdx/fv plus fdx_local/fv_local. Reset input is captured by rr. Generic recipe3 wrapper would duplicate these real pin registers and add2 more cycles. Distinct held pinpipe module has exactly1 extra explicit data/valid cycle, verified against old RTL; routed native placement/audit still required.
